openItems.id: Below the Minimum Balance · PAY-8, CF-6
openItems.explanation: Week 6 ends at $209,598.57, $40,401.43 below the $250,000.00 minimum of PAY-8. Week 6 has $734,600.00 going out and nothing coming in: PO-27-0511 Ironvale Steel Buildings $552,000.00 on December 8; Compact track loader to replace the storm-repair rental, Kestrel Ridge Equipment Quote KRE-Q-2290 $94,800.00 on December 10; SC-27-05-01 Bluepine Concrete Works $46,200.00 on December 10. The next receipts are Draw 9, Site 19 in week 7. Under CF-6 a person chooses what restores it. Option A: delay the compact track loader to replace the storm-repair rental, $94,800.00 planned December 10, which is discretionary and has no purchase order; week 6 would end at $304,398.57. Option B: draw on the construction line, at least $40,401.43 before December 8, within the $142,912.00 still available under the $5,000,000.00 commitment after Draws 8 to 10. Nothing is delayed or drawn by this forecast.

The $552,000.00 steel balance on PO-27-0511 is due on delivery, December 8, by the signed order; the billing forecast says January 7. The project manager's billing forecast puts the balance owed to Ironvale Steel Buildings at an invoice on delivery with the vendor file's net 30 terms, so it would be paid in the January 7 run. The signed purchase order says: "Balance of $552,000.00 due on delivery, by wire, before the packages are unloaded." Under CF-4 a payment over $100,000.00 takes its date from the signed contract, and the earlier date is used, so the forecast pays it by wire on December 8, in week 6. That is what takes week 6 below the minimum. If the vendor agrees to net 30, the payment moves to week 10; the Controller confirms the terms with Ironvale Steel Buildings and the project manager corrects one of the two.

openItems.id: Expected Receipt Without a Signed Contract · CF-2, PAY-8
openItems.explanation: Site 27 is on the billing schedule for December 23 at $447,265.00 of net payment, with no signed construction contract. Business development lists Harborline Storage Co. for Site 27 at $455,000.00: "Letter of intent signed October 28; construction contract in negotiation; no customer deposit" Under CF-2 a contract payment is forecast only when the construction contract is signed; a letter of intent is listed but left out, and PAY-8 says expected receipts are not cash. The forecast leaves out the $447,265.00; last week's forecast counted it in the week of December 21. If the contract is signed and the customer's deposit is received, it can come in next Monday's forecast.

Draw 9 and Draw 10, $764,288.00, are in the forecast but not yet submitted to Harrow Point Lending. Draw 9 is $174,368.00, 80% of $217,960.00 of financed hard costs billed in November, funding December 16; Draw 10 is $589,920.00, 80% of $737,400.00 of financed hard costs billed in December, funding January 15. Draw 8 is approved at $252,800.00. The planned draws assume the lender inspects and funds the full advance on time; they are expected receipts, not cash. Without them, Unrestricted Cash at January 31 would be $720,957.39, below the $750,000.00 of Section 7.3, and $892,311.32 at December 31. The Controller confirms the amounts and dates with the lender before the forecast is relied on.
